description: This PHP file defines a controller class for the 'store' module within the OpenCart admin interface. It handles displaying the module configuration page and saving settings via AJAX.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing the store module configuration page in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the store module configuration page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and form data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle AJAX request to save store module settings, checking permissions and returning success or error messages.
